briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini 3.0 escalate frontier race amid safety concerns

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI landscape intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month as compute scaling continues unabated. Regulatory pressure mounts globally while investment flows remain robust. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 achieves new SOTA on GPQA and SWE-bench while Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus with expanded context. xAI releases Grok-3 and DeepSeek launches V3 with 1.2T parameters. Meta's Llama 4 family enters public preview.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST issues new guidelines on agentic AI risks while EU AI Act enforcement begins. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level and sees early adoption in automotive and IoT pilots.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announces $15B expansion of its Arizona supercluster with 200k H200 GPUs. TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips for Google and Amazon. Energy constraints slow new data center builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols like DialectForge become standard infrastructure before the first AGI deployment?
